gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Powerful and ancient, Nordic spaces its letters like brush dabs and folds its openings shut. Noto Sans Palmyrene keeps paragraphs moving, its curves stopping short of closing so each line feels clean and modern.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-h: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau leaves its curves open-ended, a clear foil to the closed, ancient letters of Nordic. And over many lines its short climb from lowercase to capital keeps the text flowing smoothly.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Approachable and contemporary, the pair starts with Nordic, its outlines drawn by a drafting pen of constant nib width. Noto Sans PhagsPa then settles below it, its see-through c openings and gentle capital bump softening the pen-drawn lines.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-phoenicia: Bent-pipe lines of constant width, ancient and powerful. Nordic carries that look up top, while Noto Sans Phoenician offers generous lowercase height and s curves that open wide at both ends.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Nordic is all closed, cramped openings and widely spaced brush dabs. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi, with gaping mouths on the e and barely rising capitals, makes paragraphs feel approachable and easygoing.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Stout and ancient, Nordic matches its horizontals to its verticals. Noto Sans Rejang gives that closed weight a foil, its lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, each with a distinct gap.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads big and open, its curves never closing back on themselves. And Nordic is best at ancient, closed-in presence, where the body font is best at staying open and modern.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Heavy brush dabs against open daylight: Nordic closes its letters tight and keeps one constant stroke from edge to edge. Noto Sans Samaritan meets it with hefty lowercase and daylight inside every curve.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-saurashtr: Noto Sans Saurashtra reads quietly, its capitals barely taller than their neighbors and its counters staying connected to the outside. Paragraph after paragraph flows without snagging, beside closed, heavy Nordic.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-sc: Nordic holds a steady, unvarying weight from word to word, closed and powerful in its brush-dab spacing. While Noto Sans SC lets chalk curves stop well before closing, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
